subject: general
question:
In a certain code language, 

'it is very hot today' is coded as 'lu ja hu ki oi',

'it might rain today' is coded as 'ho ki ju lu',

'very hot weather today' is coded as 'ja oi kj ki' 

(Note: All codes are two letter codes only)

What is the code for 'might' in the given code language ?
solution:
The given coded sentences can be represented as-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f611873a75abdb0d672d26a79fa87bb0a7722095811ba1ccd9e10040203b1dcd.png] 

Thus, might can either be coded as 'ho' or 'ju'

Hence, 'option 3' is the correct answer.
